title: Fragments on the Psalms (Greek)
author: Origen of Alexandria
blurb: Origen, Greek fragments on the Psalms. Tip of Psalms 1–2 from locked PG 12. New English; earlier lemma-led scaffold discarded. Distinct from the Rufinus homilies on Psalms 36–38. This is not the whole psalter commentary.
era_note: Origen of Alexandria, first half of the third century. This page is a tip of the Greek psalm fragments, not a complete commentary.
first_english_note: Catena fragments on the Psalms in PG 12. No complete public-domain English of this Greek catena is used as copy-text. Rufinus’s Latin homilies on Psalms 36–38 are a different work.

text_history.method: New English from locked PG 12 / Khazarzar Greek of Fragmenta in Psalmos, Psalm 1. Earlier lemma-led SERIES-CLOSEOUT English was discarded.
